name: Customs import duty (SACU common external tariff, Schedule No. 1 Part 1)
statute: Customs Act 2018 / Customs and Excise Duty Act Cap. 50:01 (charging provision not held) and Botswana's Customs and Excise Tariff Schedule 1 Part 1 dated 01.07.2025 (BURS Tariff Volume I, R4/fetch/bw10/tariff_vol1_july2025.pdf; columns General, EU/UK, SADC, EFTA, MERCOSUR, AfCFTA)
dated: BURS Tariff Volume I dated 01.07.2025; the same rates in South Africa's consolidation of 2025-04-04 (flag: January-June not read for Botswana itself)

tests.why: beer from the US: net of VAT 1 000, value 1 000 / 1,05 = 952, 5 % = 47
beer from Germany: EU/UK column free
beer from another SACU member: free (art. 18)
cotton T-shirt from the UK: EU/UK 27 %: value 787, duty 212 (lower than MFN)
10 l of whisky from the US in bottles of 2 li or less: 154c/li x 10 = 15; value 2 000 - 15 = 1 985
whisky with a 6-digit code: the two container lines differ, grade C (no charge)

notes: BW: VAT 14 % used to take the value out of a tax-inclusive price (duty in the VAT base)
